```yaml
name: Update Generated Docs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-generated-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download generated docs artifact
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          name: generated-docs
          path: docs/generated

      - name: Generate docs with Claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: |
            # Generate documentation
            # The following files are in docs/generated
            # ...
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          max_turns: 5
          system_prompt: "You are a helpful assistant that generates documentation for Rust code."
          settings: |
            {
              "branch_name_template": "update-generated-docs",
              "base_branch": "main"
            }

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "Update generated docs"
          branch: main
          push_options: --force
```
